info.title: Citizen API
info.description: TRIGGER_CONTRACT v1. effect.hype is an absolute delta on the 0..1 scale and the result is clamped to 0..1. effect.talentCost is a relative delta: 0.12 multiplies companies.talent_cost by 1.12 and the result is floored at 0. At least one effect must be non-zero. Posting the same id replaces that trigger and reapplies the stack from each company's captured baseline; it does not stack a second copy. DELETE /api/triggers/{id} removes one trigger. DELETE /api/triggers clears every v1 trigger and restores hype and talent cost to the captured baselines. Input deltas are bounded (hype -1..1, talentCost -100..100, at most 4 decimal places) so the NUMERIC(12,2) talent column cannot overflow from a single field. A company inserted while triggers are already active keeps its own hype and talent cost until the next trigger create, replace, delete, or clear. effect.talentCost does not change burn. burnRate is the stored Slice 1 burn times the employee talentMultiplier, rounded. No employees leaves talentMultiplier at 1, so an integer stored burn is unchanged. The Host header must be localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] on the bound port; anything else is 403.

get.summary: List v1 real-world triggers, newest first

200.description: Trigger records mapped from real_world_triggers.client_id and effects. Legacy trigger types are omitted.

post.summary: Validate, store, and apply a v1 trigger. The same id replaces the previous effect.

delete.summary: Clear every v1 trigger and restore company hype and talent cost to their captured baselines

204.description: Cleared. Legacy trigger rows are left in place. Repeating the request stays empty.

delete.summary: Remove one v1 trigger by client id and recompute every company from its baseline

404.description: No v1 trigger with that id

post.summary: Insert one of the three TRIGGER_CONTRACT sample triggers

201.description: Stored sample trigger. Sending the same scenario again replaces that id.

get.summary: Read company metrics after v1 trigger effects have been recomputed from baselines

200.description: Companies. baselines are the values captured before the first v1 trigger. talentMultiplier and talentMix come from employees. baseBurnRate is the stored Slice 1 burn. burnRate is round(baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier).

ForbiddenHost.description: The Host header is not localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] on the bound port.

Effect.description: At least one of hype or talentCost must be non-zero. A field may be present and 0 when the other is non-zero.

hype.description: Absolute delta on the 0..1 hype scale. 0.1 raises hype by 10 points from the company baseline. Results are clamped to 0..1.

talentCost.description: Relative delta. 0.12 multiplies the company talent-cost baseline by 1.12. Results are floored at 0.

department.description: Canonical lowercase department. Null when the employee department is NULL or blank. Unknown names weigh 1.

weight.description: Department weight: tech 1.25, marketing 1.05, sales 0.95, otherwise 1.

contribution.description: This group's share of talentMultiplier, rounded to 4 decimal places.

Company.description: hype and talentCost are the stacked values when this row already has baselines. A NULL hype or talent_cost falls back to its baseline column, then to 0.3 or 4000. Numeric company fields are never null. talentMix.department is null only when the employee department is NULL or blank. A company created while v1 triggers are active is not rewritten until the next trigger create, replace, delete, or clear. There is no baselines.talentMultiplier. effect.talentCost does not change talentMultiplier or burnRate.

burnRate.description: Effective monthly burn: round(baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier). With no employees this stays the stored integer burn. Always a finite number.

baseBurnRate.description: Stored companies.burn_rate, the Slice 1 burn before the employee multiplier. Previously returned as burnRate. A NULL burn_rate is returned as 0, the column default. Always a finite number.

talentMultiplier.description: Mean of per-employee department weight times skill factor, rounded to 4 decimal places. Exactly 1 when the company has no counted employees. Always a finite number.

talentMix.description: Department groups. contribution is that group's share of talentMultiplier. Rounded shares sum to talentMultiplier.

hype.description: Stacked hype. A NULL hype column falls back to hype_baseline, then the column default 0.3. The response never sends null.

talentCost.description: Stacked talent cost in dollars. A NULL talent_cost column falls back to talent_cost_baseline, then the column default 4000. The response never sends null.
